TextBlock.Text: CORAL SEA. Port Moresby has asked for engineering plant, medical stores and fuel, and the Pukpuk arrangements mean we deliver them. Four priority hulls are in company with HOBART, ARAFURA and SUPPLY, and a Wedgetail is up with a tanker behind it. Ninety minutes ago a Poseidon dropped a field on a diesel-electric contact across the planned track. The masters want to press on at twelve knots. We want time to classify it. You will not get both. Three of four must reach the Moresby approach box, and the medical and engineering ship is not one of the three you can trade away. Background traffic in this sea is ordinary commerce - it is not joining your convoy and it is not your enemy.
Cargo: Get three of four priority ships into the Moresby box Medical: MV Kokoda Star must arrive Neutrals: Harm no neutral shipping
HMAS Hobart, HMAS Arafura, HMAS Supply, four priority merchants, E-7A Wedgetail and a KC-46 on the tanker track. One Type 039C in the area. Port Moresby is open behind you.
75 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.
Destroying a neutral contact ends the operation in failure. Identify before you shoot.

[DEPRECATED] E-7A Wedgetail, KC-46A Pegasus - Strategic Tanker, Auxilliary Merchant Pack, RE-power: the resupply mod, Merchants Expanded, Modern US Airbase, Buildings and Targets for Missions, PLAN Submarines, MH-60R Seahawk, RAAF F-35A Lighting II, the base game, this pack.
